parameters.Normal Format: Switch between DirectX (the Y axis points up) and OpenGL (the Y axis points down) Normal Map formats. Effectively inverts the green channel.
parameters.Balance: Adjusts the balance of specific internal maps (e.g., Curvature, AO) before they're combined into the final mask, shifting midpoint toward black or white like a brightness control.
parameters.Contrast: Adjusts the contrast/falloff of specific internal maps (e.g., Curvature, AO) before they're combined into the final mask.
parameters.Invert: Inverts specific internal maps (e.g., Curvature, AO) before they're combined into the final mask.
parameters.Tiling: Controls the amount of times the result should tile.
parameters.Seed: Assign a random value to create a different variation without changing the overall settings.
parameters.Global Invert: Inverts the final result after all effects are combined.
parameters.Global Blur: Blurs the final mask uniformly after all effects are combined.
parameters.Global Contrast: Adjusts the contrast of the final mask after all effects are combined.
parameters.Global Balance: Shifts the balance of the final mask after all effects are combined between black or white, like a brightness adjustment.
parameters.Blur: Blurs specific internal maps (e.g., Curvature, AO) before they're combined into the final mask.
parameters.Brightness: Adjusts the brightness of specific internal maps (e.g., Curvature, AO) before they're combined into the final mask.
parameters.Blending Mode: Sets the blending operation to be used. See the dedicated page about blending modes.
parameters.Right to Left: Defines how the effect is applied from left to right across the Mesh.
parameters.Top To Bottom: Defines how the effect is applied from top to bottom across the Mesh.
parameters.Front to Back: Defines how the effect is applied from front to back across the Mesh.
parameters.Texture Opacity: Controls the visibility of the custom texture.
parameters.Grayscale Conversion: Controls how a color input map is turned into a black and white mask before it’s used. See the dedicated page about grayscale conversion.
parameters.Triplanar:
When Triplanar is enabled, the texture is projected from three directions (X, Y, Z axes) instead of relying only on UVs. 

- Without triplanar the texture follows the UV layout. 
- With triplanar the texture is projected from multiple angles and blended
parameters.Triplanar Contrast: Controls how smooth a texture blends when it is projected using triplanar mapping.
parameters.AO Radius: Controls the radius (range) of the Ambient Occlusion.
parameters.AO Depth: Controls the depth (intensity) of the Ambient Occlusion.
parameters.Micro Height: Toggle usage of a custom Micro Height map on or off.
parameters.Micro Normal: Toggle usage of a custom Micro Normal map on or off.
parameters.Grunge Amount: Controls the amount of the grunge details.
parameters.Grunge Scale: Controls the scale of the grunge details.
parameters.Scale: Adjusts the scale of the texture.
parameters.Position: Shifts the midpoint of the specific channel, similar to a brightness control.
parameters.Luminosity: Adjust the luminosity (brightness) of the result.
parameters.Saturation: Adjusts the saturation of the result.
parameters.Luma: Adjusts the luma of the result.
parameters.Chroma: Adjusts the chroma of the result.
parameters.Hue: Adjusts the hue of the result.
parameters.Spread: Adjusts the spread which results in softer or sharper transition.
parameters.Lightness: Adjusts the lightness of the result.
parameters.Apply To Alpha: Applies it as well to the alpha channel.
parameters.Brushing Intensity: Adjusts the intensity of the brushed metal effect.
parameters.Triplanar Mapping:
| When Triplanar is enabled, the texture is projected from three directions (X, Y, Z axes) instead of relying only on UVs.

- Without triplanar the texture follows the UV layout.
- With triplanar the texture is projected from multiple angles and blended. |
